notes: One row per provider (provider_approval_number). entity_form is a conservative classification of Legal Name by suffix and keyword; it is a heuristic, not a legal determination. likely_individual rows have legal_name and trading_name null and name_withheld true (CLAUDE.md rule 2). Addresses are not carried over. service_count joins on provider_approval_number in the services table; providers with no services in that table have service_count 0, which is not evidence that they operate none.
